armySpecialRules.name: State Troops
armySpecialRules.description:
State Troops are trained to support and protect each
other in battle. If an enemy unit declares a charge
against a State Troop unit, and that unit does not flee as
a charge reaction, then all unengaged State Troop units
within 3" can make either a Support Fire or a Counter
Charge action by passing a Leadership test (which can
be re-rolled if the unit has a Leader). These actions are
declared immediately after their State Troops' charge
reaction. If the charged State Troops unit does not get a
charge reaction for any reason then the other State
Troops units within range cannot make a Support Fire
or a Counter Charge action.
Additionally, a State Troop unit can only declare one
Support Fire action, one Stand and Shoot reaction or
one Counter Charge action per turn.
• Support Fire: A State Troop unit can only declare a
Support Fire action if at least one model in the unit is
armed with a missile weapon and the range between
the charging unit and the charged State Troops unit is
greater than the charging unit's Movement
characteristic.
If a Support Fire action is declared, the unit makes an
immediate, out of sequence shooting attack, resolved
as if it had just declared a Stand and Shoot charge
reaction against the charging unit. All unsaved
Wounds from the units' Stand and Shoot charge
reaction and/or Support Fire actions, are combined
when determining if the charging unit is required to
take a Heavy Casualties Panic test.
• Counter Charge: A State Troop unit can declare a
Counter Charge against an enemy unit's unengaged
arc, after your opponent has moved all of their
charging units, as long as one or more enemy units
has successfully completed a charge against the
charged State Troop unit. If a Counter Charge action
is declared, the unit makes an out of sequence move
that is resolved as it had just declared a charge
against the charging unit. The enemy does not get to
make any charge reactions against a Counter Charge,
but otherwise all the normal charging rules and
bonuses apply.

Grenade launching blunderbusses have the following

armySpecialRules.description:
Hochland long rifles have the following profile:
Range: Strength: Special Rules:

armySpecialRules.description:
Repeater handguns have the following profile:
Range: Strength: Special Rules:
24" 4 Armour Piercing (1),

armySpecialRules.name: Repeater Pistol
armySpecialRules.description:
Repeater pistols have the following profile:
Range: Strength: Special Rules:
12" 4 Armour Piercing (1),
Multiple Shots (3),
Quick to Fire,
Rapid Fire
In close combat, a repeater pistol counts as an
additional hand weapon that does not give the model
the Parry special rule.
A repeater pistol can be used in combination with a
regular pistol as a brace of pistols, in which case they
fire Multiple Shots (4), but do not have Rapid Fire.

magicItems.name: Runefang
magicItems.description:
Imperial General only. All hits from a Runefang wound
automatically and Ignores Armour saves.

magicItems.name: Sword Of Sigismund
magicItems.description:
The Sword of Sigismund gives the wielder +1 Strength
and the Always Strikes First special rule.

magicItems.name: Daemonslayer Blade
magicItems.description:
Against Daemons, all attacks made with the
Daemonslayer Blade gain +1 To Wound with the
Multiple Wounds (D3) special rule.

magicItems.name: Spear Of The Hierophant
magicItems.description:
Light lance/spear. Against Daemons, Undead and
Vampires, all attacks made with the Spear of the
Hierophant gain +1 Strength and any successful Ward
Saves must be re-rolled.

magicItems.name: Sword Of Fate
magicItems.description:
At the beginning of the battle, nominate one enemy
Character; Monstrous Creature or Monster. The Sword
of Fate will Wound that model on a 2+ with the Ignores
Armour Saves and Multiple Wounds (D3) special rules.

magicItems.name: Sword Of Power
magicItems.description:
The Sword of Power gives the wielder +2 Strength and
the Armour Piercing (1) special rule.

magicItems.name: The Griffon Claw
magicItems.description:
The Griffon Claw gives the model +1 To Hit in close
combat as well as the Armour Piercing (1) special rule.

magicItems.name: Hammer Of Judgement
magicItems.description:
Models hit by the Hammer of Judgement must take a
Toughness test for every Hit suffered. If the test is
failed, the Hit Wounds automatically with the Ignores
Armour Saves special rule. If the test is passed, roll to
Wound and take armour saves as normal.

magicItems.name: The Mace Of Helsturm
magicItems.description:
Great weapon. Instead of attacking normally, the bearer
can choose to forfeit all of his normal Attacks to make
a single, special Attack. If this Attack hits, it is resolved
at Strength 10 and has both the Flaming Attacks and
Multiple Wounds (D3) special rules.

magicItems.name: Sword Of Righteous Steel
magicItems.description:
The Sword of Righteous Steel makes the wielder
always Hit any opponent on roll of a 2+. In addition,
any successful Parry saves must be re-rolled.

magicItems.name: Blessed Sword
magicItems.description:
All failed To Hit rolls made with the Blessed Sword
may be re-rolled.

magicItems.name: Wyrmslayer Sword
magicItems.description:
The Wyrmslayer Sword makes the wielder Wound on a
4+ or better, and ignores Natural Armour.

magicItems.name: The Armour Of Meteoric Iron
magicItems.description:
The Armour of Meteoric Iron grants the wearer both a
1+ armour save and a 6+ Ward save.

magicItems.name: Armour Of Tarnus
magicItems.description:
Light armour. The Armour of Tarnus gives the wearer a
5+ Ward Save. In addition, this armour can be chosen
by Wizards even though they are not normally allowed
to wear armour.

magicItems.name: Shield Of The Medusa
magicItems.description:
Shield. At the start of each round of close combat, the
Shield of the Medusa causes one enemy model in base
contact of your choosing to suffer a -1 penalty to their
Attack characteristic for the remainder of the close
combat phase.

magicItems.name: Shroud Of Magnus
magicItems.description:
This item gives the bearer a 5+ Ward save and the
Magic Resistance (2) special rule. In addition, any unit
joined by the character wearing the Shroud gain
Immunity (Fear, Terror).

magicItems.name: Amulet Of Thrice-Blessed Copper
magicItems.description:
All enemy attacks targeting the model wearing the
Amulet of Thrice-Blessed Copper suffer -1 To Wound.
In addition, the bearer gains the Immunity (Poisoned
Attacks) special rule.

magicItems.name: Icon Of Sigmar
magicItems.description:
Arch Lector only. The Icon of Sigmar gives its bearer
+1 Toughness.

magicItems.name: Jade Amulet
magicItems.description:
The Jade Amulet allows the wearer to ignore the first
wounding Hit they suffer (after saves).

magicItems.name: The Crimson Amulet
magicItems.description:
The Crimson Amulet gives the wearer a 6+ Ward Save.
In addition, they automatically pass any Characteristic
tests they have to take.

magicItems.name: Sigil Of Sigmar
magicItems.description:
The Sigil of Sigmar gives the bearer a 4+ Ward save
against all enemy spells.

magicItems.name: Grey Wand
magicItems.description:
The Grey Wand gives the wielder a +D3 casting bonus.
Roll for each spell casting attempt.

magicItems.name: Chalice Of Fate
magicItems.description:
The Chalice of Fate allows the Wizard to re-roll failed
Channelling rolls.

magicItems.name: Seal Of Destruction
magicItems.description:
One use only. After the bearer of the Seal of
Destruction manages to successfully dispel an enemy
spell, they may choose to use the Seal. If they do so,
roll a D6. On a 4+, the spell cannot be used by that
Wizard for the rest of the game.

magicItems.name: Shemtek'S Grimoire
magicItems.description:
One use only. This item can be used at the start of any
enemy Magic Phase. Roll a D3, the result is the casting
penalty all enemy Wizards suffer for the duration of
this Magic Phase.

magicItems.name: Crystal Ball
magicItems.description:
The Crystal Ball allows the wearer to pick one enemy
unit anywhere on the table at the start of each of your
turns. Your opponent must reveal all Magic Items,
Hidden models and the like that unit might have.

magicItems.name: Van Horstmann'S Speculum
magicItems.description:
When the wearer fights in a challenge, he must 'swap'
the Weapon Skill, Strength, Toughness, Initiative and
Attacks characteristics on his profile with his enemy
(but not the enemy's mount, if he has one). So, the
wearer fights with his enemy's Strength, Toughness,
Initiative and Attacks whilst his enemy fights with the
wearer's Strength, Toughness, Initiative and Attacks.
Note that you cannot choose not to use Van
Horstmann's Speculum and you must swap all of the
listed characteristics for the duration of the challenge,
not just some of them.

magicItems.name: Aldred'S Casket Of Sorcery
magicItems.description:
Bound Spell (power level variable). At the start of each
of his Magic phases, the bearer may remove and
capture one randomly determined spell from an enemy
Wizard within 12" of him on a roll of 4+. The bearer
can then cast the captured spell in any of his own
Magic phases by releasing it from the casket just like
from a Bound Spell, whereupon the spell is then
removed from the game. Any number of spells may be
captured by the casket, and the bearer can cast each one
once, either over several magic phases or all at the
same time if they prefer. The power level of the spell
cast by the casket will be equivalent to the normal
casting value of the spell.

magicItems.name: Doomfire Ring
magicItems.description:
Bound Spell, Power Level 6. The Doomfire Ring
contains the Burning Head spell from the Lore of Fire.

magicItems.name: Eichelbaum'S Scroll
magicItems.description:
Witch Hunter only. Once per turn, when an enemy spell
has been cast, the bearer can use this item instead of
attempting to dispel the spell by using dispel dice. This
gives them 3 free dice to attempt to dispel the spell,
which cannot be combined with any other dispel dice.
This may also be used to dispel spells that Remains in
Play. However, if the dispel attempt fails, the scroll is
destroyed and cannot be used for the remainder of the
battle.

magicItems.name: Helsturm'S Staff
magicItems.description:
Arch Lector only. The model carrying Helsturm's Staff
and any unit they join gain the Cold-blooded special
rule.

magicItems.name: Balestorm Orb
magicItems.description:
Witch Hunter only. Enemy Wizards within 24" of the
bearer suffer a -1 penalty to cast spell.

magicItems.name: Brazier Of Holy Flame
magicItems.description:
The bearer of this item gains the Hold Your Ground (6)
special rule.

magicItems.name: Blessed Silver Hammer
magicItems.description:
Any enemy model with the Daemonic, Undead or
Vampiric special rule in base contact suffers a Strength
4 Hit at the start of each round of close combat.

magicItems.name: Ring Of St. Horst
magicItems.description:
The model carrying the Ring of St. Horst and any unit
they join may re-roll any failed Leadership test.

magicItems.name: Ring Of Volans
magicItems.description:
One use only. Bound Spell (power level variable). At
the beginning of the game, choose one spells from any
of the eight Winds of Magic as if the bearer were a
Level 1 Wizard. That spell is bound within the Ring of
Volans is automatically cast with a power level equal to
the normal casting value of the spell, no power dice are
required.

magicItems.name: Book Of Uncommon Prayer
magicItems.description:
The bearer may re-roll one dice when taking
Leadership tests to use Battle Prayers of Sigmar.

magicItems.name: Boots Of Bovva
magicItems.description:
Model on foot only. The model wearing the Boots of
Boova gains the Stomp special rule, but it only inflicts
D3 hits rather than D6.

magicItems.name: Icon Of Magnus
magicItems.description:
The Icon of Magnus gives the bearer and any unit they
are with the Immunity (Terror) special rule.

magicItems.name: The Powders Of Thrice-Damned Ossk
magicItems.description:
Witch Hunter only. One use only. The Powders may be
used immediately when an enemy Wizard miscasts.
The Wizard must roll twice on the Miscast table, and
you pick which result is used.

magicItems.name: Reliquary Of Lector Ostranald
magicItems.description:
Each time the bearer's unit suffers unsaved Wounds
from a spell, the first D3 unsaved Wounds are absorbed
by the Reliquary and have no effect (unsaved Wounds
with the Multiple Wounds special rule still only count
as one).

magicItems.name: Sanctified Shard Of Lichebone
magicItems.description:
Witch Hunter only. No Ward saves may be taken
against close combat Attacks made by the bearer.

magicItems.name: The Silver Horn
magicItems.description:
Bound Spell, Power Level 3. The Silver Horn contains
an augment spell that targets all fleeing friendly units
within 24". The target units will automatically Rally.

magicItems.name: Skull Charm
magicItems.description:
At the start of the game, roll a D6 and consult the chart
below to determine which effect the Skull Charm has
on the wearer.
D6 Result
1-2 +1 Weapon Skill
3-4 +1 Leadership
5-6 +1 Weapon Skill & Leadership

magicItems.name: Von Mecklenburg'S Enchanted Shot
magicItems.description:
Witch Hunter with pistol only. Any shots fired from the
bearer pistol(s) have the Magical Attacks special rule
and automatically Wounds.

magicItems.name: Dazh'S Flint
magicItems.description:
The model bearing Dazh's Flint gains the Flaming
Attacks special rule.

magicItems.name: The Fang Of Orska
magicItems.description:
Any War Beast, Monstrous Beast, Monstrous Creature
or Monster attempting to strike blows against the
bearer must first pass a Leadership test or
automatically forfeit any attacks directed against the
bearer.

magicItems.name: Sheen Of Truesilver
magicItems.description:
At the end of any close combat in which a Monstrous
Creature or Monster suffers one or more unsaved
Wounds from the bearer's close combat attacks, it must
take a Toughness test for each such Wound inflict, and
loses a Wound (with no saves allowed) for each test
failed.

magicItems.name: Sanctified Silver Bullets
magicItems.description:
Witch Hunter with pistol(s) only. Any shots fired from
the bearer pistol(s) have the Multiple Wounds (D3)
special rule against Daemons, Undead and Vampires.

magicItems.name: The Imperial Banner
magicItems.description:
All units within 12" of this banner gain the Cold-
blooded special rule.

magicItems.name: Flag Of The Conqueror
magicItems.description:
All friendly units with the State Troops or Militia
special rules within 12" gain +1 to their Leadership.

magicItems.name: Griffon Standard
magicItems.description:
A unit bearing the Griffon Banner doubles any combat
result bonus granted for having extra ranks. However,
the unit carrying the Griffon Banner cannot pursue a
fleeing enemy and must hold their ground instead.

magicItems.name: Banner Of Sigismund
magicItems.description:
The unit carrying the Banner of Sigismund gains the
Stubborn special rule. If the unit is already Stubborn,
they instead become Unbreakable.

magicItems.name: Black Skull Of The Caliph
magicItems.description:
The unit carrying the Black Skull of the Caliph, and all
friendly units within 6" of it, gain the Immunity (Fear)
special rule.

magicItems.name: Steel Standard
magicItems.description:
Cavalry or Monstrous Cavalry only. The unit carrying
the Steel Standard ignores the Movement penalties
from barding.

knightly_orders.name: Reiksguard Knights
knightly_orders.description:
Cavalry/Infantry 1 point per model
Monstrous Cavalry 3 points per model
Must take heavy lances or polearms if mounted. The
models have the Stubborn special rule. However, they
may not take a regular Grand Master.

knightly_orders.name: Knights Of The Blazing Sun
knightly_orders.points:
Characters free
Cavalry 1 point per model
Monstrous Cavalry 3 points per model
knightly_orders.description:
Must take heavy lances or polearms. Whenever a unit
where the majority of models have this upgrade declare
a charge, the unit being charged suffer -1 Weapon Skill
and Ballistic Skill for the duration of the turn.

knightly_orders.name: Knights Panther
knightly_orders.points:
Characters free
Cavalry 1 point per model
knightly_orders.description:
Must take heavy lances or polearms. A unit where all
models have this upgrade add an extra D3" to their
charge distance.

knightly_orders.name: Knights Of The White Wolf
knightly_orders.points:
Characters 5 points
Cavalry 1 point per model
knightly_orders.description:
Must take cavalry hammers. The models have the
Hatred special rule against enemy models with a lower
Weapon Skill, Strength, Toughness or Leadership
characteristic than they have. In addition, they have the
Natural Armour (6+) special rule against missile
attacks.

knightly_orders.name: Black Guard Of Morr
knightly_orders.description:
Cavalry/Infantry 1 point per model
Must take polearms on foot. The models have the Fear
and Loner special rules.

knightly_orders.name: Knights Griffon
knightly_orders.points:
Characters free
Cavalry 1 point per model
Monstrous Cavalry 3 points per model
knightly_orders.description:
Must take heavy lances or polearms. The unit may
attempt to use a Swift Reform at the start of the turn
instead of the Remaining Moves sub-phase. However,
they will halve their Charge distance that turn if they
do so. In addition, they may not choose Flee as a
charge reaction, refuse a challenge and ignore
Swiftstride when fleeing.
Orders below as detailed in the army list. A Grand
ngs to the same Knightly Order. You may only field one
and Chapter Masters must either be armed with a hand

knightly_orders.name: Knights Of The Everlasting Light
knightly_orders.points:
Characters 10 points
Cavalry 1 point per model
knightly_orders.description:
Must take heavy lances or great weapons. The models
gain the Magical Attacks special rule and may re-roll
failed armour saves in close combat. However, they
must re-roll successful armour saves from missile
attacks and successful Dangerous Terrain tests.

knightly_orders.name: Knights Of Sigmar'S Blood
knightly_orders.points:
Characters free
Cavalry 1 point per model
knightly_orders.description:
Must take heavy lances or polearms. The models have
the Inspiring Presence (6) special rule. However, they
may not be upgraded to Inner Circle Knights.

knightly_orders.name: Knights Of The Black Bear
knightly_orders.description:
Must take heavy lances or polearms. This unit always
counts as having one more rank than it actually has for
the purpose of determining Steadfast, and enemy units
cannot claim the Outnumber bonus against it. However,
it must re-roll successful Leadership tests for Marching
when within 8" of enemy units, Redirecting a Charge,
Reforming from Defeat after losing a round of close
combat, Restraining from Pursuit or Swift Reform.

knightly_orders.name: Knights Of The Twin-Tailed Orb
knightly_orders.points:
Characters 15 points
Cavalry 2 points per model
knightly_orders.description:
The unit is armed with flails instead of heavy lances.
The models have the Flaming Attacks and Frenzy
special rules.

knightly_orders.name: Knights Encarmine
knightly_orders.description:
The unit is armed with two hand weapons instead of
heavy lances. The models may re-roll 1's To Hit in
close combat and can Parry while mounted. However,
they cannot gain any bonus from ranks (including
Steadfast) or Disrupt enemy units.

knightly_orders.name: Sons Of Manann
knightly_orders.points:
Characters 15 points
Cavalry 2 points per model
knightly_orders.description:
The unit is armed with polearms & shields instead of
heavy lances. The models (but not their mounts) gain
+1 To Hit in the first round of close combat.
